description: This file contains the implementation of the LU matrix decomposition class, including methods for extracting lower and upper triangular matrices, pivot handling, and solving linear systems.

classes.name: LU
classes.description: A class implementing LU decomposition of a matrix, providing methods for factorization, pivot management, and solving linear equations.

methods.name: getL
methods.description: Returns the lower triangular matrix from the LU decomposition.

methods.name: getU
methods.description: Returns the upper triangular matrix from the LU decomposition.

methods.name: getP
methods.description: Returns the permutation matrix associated with pivoting.

methods.name: getPivot
methods.description: Returns the pivot vector indicating row permutations.

methods.name: isNonsingular
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is non-singular (i.e., has a non-zero determinant).

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the system A*X = B using the LU decomposition.
